approval_reference: Roles fixed by the assignment algorithm before any score was computed; approved for preparing the development people's inputs.
assignment_algorithm: Sort canonical eligible IDs by SHA256 of 'XSUB EEG1 pilot assignment v1|seed={seed}|{person}', tie-break by ID; first22 source, next24 confirmation; first4 source-ranked IDs pseudo-targets. Store each role list in canonical ID order.
eligibility_policy: Strict published-flag exclusion: sub-01, sub-06, sub-18 and sub-23 are excluded; the original score-blind 22/24 allocation is kept.
warning: No outcome or score was used to set or change the roles.
channel_mapping_reference: Header audit consistent (sampling rate, reference, channels, signal size).
